ya2.2.3:131.1: Suddhāvāsaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha s.kh. nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha v.kh. uppajjittha: itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha s.kh. ca nirujjhissati, v.kh. ca uppajjittha. 11. i.
ya2.2.3:132.1: Yassa r.kh. nuppajjittha, tassa v.kh. na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.
ya2.2.3:133.1: Yassa vā pana v.kh. na nirujjhissati, tassa r.kh. nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.
ya2.2.3:134.1: Yassa v.kh. nuppajittha, tassa s.kh. na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.
ya2.2.3:135.1: Yassa vā pana s.kh. na nirujjhissati, tassa v.kh. nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha. ii.
ya2.2.3:137.1: Yassa yattha r.kh. nuppajjittha, tassa tattha v.kh na nirujjhissatīti?
ya2.2.3:138.1: Suddhāvāsaṃ uppajjantānaṃ arūpānaṃ tesaṃ tattha r.kh. nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha v.kh. na nirujjhissati; suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha r.kh. ca nuppajjittha, v.kh. ca na nirujjhissati.
ya2.2.3:139.1: Yassa vā pana yattha v.kh. na nirujjhissati, tassa tattha r.kh. nuppajjitthāti?
ya2.2.3:140.1: Pañcavokāre parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha v.kh. na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha r.kh. nuppajjittha; suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ arūpe parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha v.kh. ca na nirujjhissati, r.kh. ca nuppajjittha.
ya2.2.3:141.1: Yassa yattha v.kh. nuppajjittha, tassa tattha s.kh. na nirujjhissatīti?
ya2.2.3:142.1: Suddhāvāsaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha v.kh. nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha s.kh. na nirujjhissati; suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha v.kh. ca nuppajjittha, s.kh. ca na nirujjhissati.
ya2.2.3:143.1: Yassa vā pana yattha s.kh. na nirujjhissati, tassa tattha v.kh. nuppajjitthāti?
ya2.2.3:144.1: Parinibbantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha s.kh. na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha v.kh. nuppajjittha; suddhāvāse parinibbantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha s.kh. ca na nirujjhissati, v.kh. ca nuppajjittha.
